label: O-acetyltransferase activity
recommended_action: add as a lead, general level
suggested_evidence: ISS from PMID 25165982 or IDA if a curator accepts the in vitro assay
rationale: AlgJ has a complete SGNH triad and measured acetylesterase activity, and loss of algJ abolishes alginate acetylation in vivo. The acceptor is unidentified, so a general transferase term is the most specific defensible MF.

label: carboxylic ester hydrolase activity
rationale: Covers the directly measured acetylesterase activity. Record as a measured activity, not as the physiological function.

label: alginate O-acetyltransferase activity
recommended_action: request a new term only after the acceptor is determined
rationale: GO has no MF for this chemistry. Requesting a term now would fix a direction (polymer versus carrier) that the evidence does not support.

label: protein binding
rationale: Uninformative, and the AlgJ-AlgF-AlgX interactions are better captured by the BP and CC terms below.

label: alginic acid acetylation
current_state_on_Q88ND3: absent on Q88ND3, present on P. aeruginosa Q51393 (IMP PMID 12003941, IDA PMID 8636017)
suggested_evidence: ISS or IBA from the P. aeruginosa ortholog
rationale: Direct orthology, same operon order, 57.0 percent identity, full conservation of the triad, the oxyanion hole and the acidic patch.

label: alginic acid biosynthetic process
rationale: Supported, but less informative than GO:0051979.

label: periplasmic space
suggested_evidence: ISS from PMID 12003941 and the 4O8V construct boundary 75-370
rationale: Consistent with an Nin-Cout anchor and a crystallised periplasmic catalytic domain.

label: plasma membrane
rationale: A single N-terminal hydrophobic segment (about residues 4-22) anchors the protein; an uncleaved type II signal anchor was shown experimentally.

label: single-pass membrane protein
rationale: A cleaved signal peptide and an uncleaved signal anchor imply different CC assignments. The sequence shows one hydrophobic maximum and a positive-inside N-terminus.

label: AlgJFXK acetylation and export complex
rationale: No structure or direct interaction evidence places AlgJ in the complex. The 7ULA structure contains only AlgK and AlgX, and the 4O8V A-B contact is crystal packing.
